title: game/phrases.json
description: The phrase sheet: the phrases the learner says or hears, with their support card and recordings. content/PHRASES.md is the source of truth (D-game-10); PhraseSheetTests keeps the two in step. Loaded by PhraseSheet (Vocaterra.Game.Core).

id.description: A stable id (pedir-agua); saves and lessons name it.

says.description: Who says it: the learner (says), an NPC (hears) or both.

spanish.description: The phrase in the target language.

english.description: Its meaning in the support language.

intent.description: The core intent the phrase expresses, or null for a phrase only heard.

prompt.description: The bundle prompt the phrase belongs to.

variants.description: Other spellings the learner may say for the same row.

card.description: The support card: 'phrase = meaning · word = meaning'.

audioLineIds.description: The speech lines that say the phrase.
